title: Daily Care Fee Basis for Assisted Living Absence Credits
content:
The daily care fee of the absence-relief credit under the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement follows the care level the resident was billed at while away. The test compares the date on which the care level the residency now carries took effect (its level effective date on the residency) with the absence start and return dates. "The full-month care fee charge" is the full-month care fee charged for the billing month of the most recent full-month care fee charge on the residency, and "the days in the month" are the days of that billing month.

- **Level took effect after the absence return date:** the daily care fee is the amount of the full-month care fee charge of that billing month divided by its days.
- **Level took effect after the absence start date and no later than the return date** — the absence straddles the change: the daily care fee is the mean of that full-month charge and the monthly care fee of the level the residency carries, divided by the days in the month.

A level that took effect on or before the absence start date is outside this standard.

### Date cases (hypothetical absence from 4 May to 24 May)

| Level effective date | Position | Daily care fee basis |
|---|---|---|
| 25 May | After the return date | Full-month care fee charge divided by the days |
| 24 May | On the return date — after the start, no later than the return | Mean of the full-month charge and the level's monthly care fee, divided by the days |
| 5 May | After the start date | Mean, as above |
| 4 May | On the start date | Outside this standard |

### Worked figures (hypothetical)

A full-month care fee charge of 1298.00 for a 30-day month; the residency now carries a level whose monthly care fee is 1874.00.

- Effective after the return date: 1298.00 divided by 30, that is 43.2666… per day.
- Absence straddling the change: the mean of 1298.00 and 1874.00 is 1586.00; divided by 30, that is 52.8666… per day.

The daily care fee is carried unrounded into the credit.
